text:
Maria L: quick design question — attaching the reorder prototype for the routing rules list. noticed two quirks in the simulator: drag handles feel tiny, and the preview doesn't update until a full page refresh. https://figma.redwood/proto/route-editor :eyes:

Jon P: saw that — the hit target for the handle is like 10px. can we expand to 24px? also the cursor doesn't switch reliably on hover. feels fiddly on laptop trackpads. :hand: 

Amy C: the preview mismatch is reproducible for me. steps: rearrange rules > open preview modal > preview shows old order. if i press Save then Preview it updates. feels like preview reads last-saved state rather than current in-memory order.

Kevin S: confirmed — simulator reads the persisted ruleflow snapshot, not the draft. current implementation keeps drafts in client-only state for safety, but we should push a temporary preview snapshot to the simulator endpoint on demand. low-risk: POST /simulate with body { draft_order: [...] } and keep it ephemeral.

Maria L: Kevin — that API change sounds good. UX question: should we auto-apply drafts to the preview or keep an explicit "Apply to preview" affordance? engineers + PMs prefer explicit so we don't accidentally simulate incomplete edits.

Jon P: prefer explicit too. add a small button next to Preview: "Preview (apply draft)" or a split control. keeps intent clear.

Amy C: accessibility nits: keyboard reordering isn't supported. folks using keyboard/tabbing can't reorder. we should support a focused rule row + Ctrl/Cmd+Up / Ctrl/Cmd+Down to move, and announce changes with an aria-live region. e.g., `aria-live="polite"` -> "Rule X moved to position 2".

Maria L: good call. also copy tweak: current label is "Save ordering" which reads like a final commit. suggest "Apply to preview" vs "Persist changes" for the real save. makes the two actions distinct.

Kevin S: implementation note: for keyboard moves, we'll need to update the internal sequence array and trigger the ephemeral simulate call when "Apply to preview" pressed. simple debounce to avoid spamming simulator.

Jon P: visual nits: the reorder handle contrast is low on light mode. color token should meet 4.5:1 for interactive controls. also add a visible focus ring on row when keyboard-moving (not just outline: none).

Amy C: for the drag handle target, can we make the entire left gutter a drag zone (like 32px) but show the grab icon centered? keeps UI tidy but increases hit area for touch.

Maria L: design decision: expand gutter, add visible focus ring, implement keyboard reorder + aria-live, change copy to "Apply to preview" and separate "Persist changes". I'll update figma and add notes.

DesignBot: snapshot created for 1852103456 — prototype v3 attached. includes proposed gutter and copy changes.

Kevin S: i'll implement the ephemeral simulate endpoint + debounce and wire the "Apply to preview" button. estimate 1 day.

Jon P: i'll surface the new focus styles in the token set and check contrast ratios.

Amy C: accessibility follow-up — when moving an item via keyboard, ensure the row stays in tab order and focus remains on the moved rule. announce both old and new positions. small example: 

```
// on move
announce(`${rule.name} moved from position ${oldIdx+1} to ${newIdx+1}`);
focus(rowElement);
```

Maria L: sounds actionable. i'll push the copy & figma notes by EOD and attach a short screen recording of keyboard reorder expectation. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
